name: Kingambit
description: Kingambit, the Big Blade Pokémon, and the evolved form of Bisharp. A Dark and Steel type.
pokedex_entries: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.
